_comment: Seed topic list — sourced from strategy-notes/2026-08-filming-source-material.md in the kbt-ai repo. These are candidates based on existing market understanding, NOT validated search/consumption data. demandScore starts at 0 for every topic; the demand-scoring agent (lib/topic-agent.js) is what replaces these zeros with real scores from competitor-channel research. Until that's run, topic-ranker.js's coverage-first sort still works correctly (all topics tied at demandScore 0 just fall through to the staleness tie-break, which is fine for an unscored list).
